title: OrderCreated
description: Event emitted by the Order Service when a new order is created and ready for payment capture. Consumed by the Payment Service to trigger a charge attempt.

event_id.description: UUID4 — uniquely identifies this Kafka event delivery (idempotency key in handlers).

correlation_id.description: Optional request correlation ID; consumer also reads from x-correlation-id header.

order_id.description: UUID of the order being paid.

customer_id.description: UUID of the customer placing the order.

amount.description: Decimal amount as a string to preserve precision (no float rounding).

payment_method_token.description: Tokenized payment method reference (e.g., pm_xxx for Stripe, pay_xxx for Razorpay).

merchant_pref.description: Optional merchant override; honored only when settings.provider_routing.respect_merchant_override=True.

region.description: Optional region/country code (e.g., 'IN', 'US'). Used for region-bias routing.

billing_country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the billing address.
